name: team_planning_overrides
description: List what a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in overrides: each subject and facet it sets or pinned, its end state, its note when it has one (`{ value }`, or `{ removed: true }` once erased; a note on a pay change only for a member with the see-pay right), who set it and when. Each also shows what the scenario would inherit without it: the nearest ancestor scenario that changes it, or the baseline. A pin names where its value came from (a null scenario_id: read off its parent's organisation, as a rule above the subject or the baseline gave it), and parent_moved whether its parent would now give it something else. A forgotten person reads as "Former member". Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
